title: Judge verdicts: LLM stage output, WRITE stage input
description: The contract between the judging model and the renderer. Validating here is what lets the report stage be a pure formatter: any drift in the model's output is caught as a schema error instead of silently producing a malformed report.

topics.description: Keys are topic names defined in the active profile.

none_reason.description: Why no pick was made. Expected whenever pick is null, so an empty result explains itself.

hard_filter_recap.description: The model restating which hard filters this listing cleared, so a wrong pick is auditable after the fact.

where_strongest.description: Concrete match points. `pool_id` optionally cites the source record backing the claim, which is what keeps the model from inventing experience.

gaps.description: Honest mismatches. Required by the prompt so the report supports an actual decision.

resume_choice.description: Free-form: which résumé variant to lead with. Values are whatever the user's own set is named.
